svg.title: watsonx.ai in three of IBM’s published results
svg.desc: UHCW NHS Trust saw more than 700 additional patients each week without added staff. CrushBank used watsonx.ai and watsonx.data to help IT support teams resolve 40% more help desk tickets per day. UFC scaled insight generation for more than 40 live events, with an estimated 3x increase in insight volume. Each figure is a customer result IBM publishes on its watsonx.ai page. IBM marks UFC’s figures as estimates.
